title: Fourier infinity norm
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, define its Fourier infinity norm to be the maximum, over all subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, of the absolute value of its Fourier coefficient at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
